tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: Return recent OHLC price candles for an asset (by asset_id from list_assets) so you can gauge the recent trend before opening a position. Required: asset_id and size (candle width in seconds — one of the supported values). Optional count (default 100, max 1000). Each candle has from/to timestamps and open/close/min/max prices.

asset_id.description: Asset id to fetch candles for, from list_assets. Must be positive.

size.description: Candle width in seconds. Must be exactly one of: 1,5,10,15,30,60,120,300,600,900,1800,3600,7200,14400,28800,43200,86400,604800,2592000 (e.g. 60 = 1-minute, 3600 = hourly, 86400 = daily). Any other value is rejected with a validation_error.

count.description: Number of most-recent candles to return. Omit or pass 0 for the default of 100; max 1000. Values above 1000 (or negative) are rejected with a validation_error.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Report this token's access mode for binary-options: read-write (write tools available to this token), read-only (market data and portfolio only), or none. The mode reflects token scopes; per-account trading restrictions may still apply at call time. Call this to learn why write tools may be absent from the tool list.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Report the gateway's rate limits so you can pace calls and avoid rate_limited errors. Limits are enforced per user — shared across all of that user's tokens, not per token — over a rolling window. There is a global gateway cap across every call, plus separate read and write buckets; each tool counts against one bucket (write tools against 'write', everything else against 'read'). This reports the static limits, not live remaining counts; a rate_limited error already carries retry_after_ms and reset_at.

tools.name: get_trade_history
tools.description: List your already-closed positions, with paging. Optional skip (records to skip; default 0) and limit (default 50, max 500). Each row has position_id, asset_id/asset_name, direction, amount, open_price/open_time, close_price/close_time, close_reason, the net profit (can be negative), and a result enum: 'win' (expired in profit), 'loss' (expired at a loss), 'equal' (expired flat), or 'canceled' (closed before expiry, e.g. sold early). Page by increasing skip in steps of limit until fewer than limit rows return.

skip.description: Number of records to skip from the start, for paging; default 0, must be >= 0 (negative is a validation_error). To page, set skip = page_index * limit.

limit.description: Maximum records to return. Omit or pass 0 for the default of 50; max 500. A larger or negative value is rejected with a validation_error. Fewer than limit rows means you have reached the end.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List tradable assets. Each row has asset_id (pass to place_trade), name, is_open (currently tradable), minimum_amount/maximum_amount for the trade amount, profit_percent (payout percent of a winning trade — pass this exact value to place_trade), the available expirations, and the early-sell (buyback) settings. By default only currently-open assets are returned; set only_enabled=false to include closed ones. Note: if your account is under regulatory trading restrictions this returns a trading_access_denied error — portfolio tools may still work, but new positions cannot be opened.

only_enabled.description: When true (the default), only assets that are currently tradable (is_open=true) are returned; set false to include closed/suspended assets too.

tools.name: list_balances
tools.description: List your trading balances. Each row has balance_id, a type ('regular' = real-money account, 'training' = demo account with imaginary funds), currency, available amount, and bonus_amount. Pass the chosen balance_id to place_trade — there is no default balance. Optional types filter: ALL (default), NORMAL (regular only), TRAINING (demo only).

types.description: Optional balance-type filter (case-insensitive). ALL (default; regular + training), NORMAL (regular only), TRAINING (demo only). Omit for ALL; any other value is rejected with a validation_error.

tools.name: list_positions
tools.description: List your currently open positions on one balance (balance_id from list_balances). Each row carries position_id (pass to sell_position or rollover_position), asset_id/asset_name, direction, amount staked, open_price/open_time, the live current_price, expected_profit (net of the staked amount, negative when losing), sell_profit (net result if sold now), expiration, and seconds_remaining.

balance_id.description: The balance to list open positions for, from list_balances.

tools.name: place_trade
tools.description: Open a new binary-options position. Pass balance_id (from list_balances), asset_id plus its current profit_percent (both from list_assets), direction 'call' (price will be above the open quote at expiration) or 'put' (below), the amount to stake, and expired — the expiration time as unix seconds (UTC), picked from the asset's expirations list returned by list_assets (do not compute your own boundary — the listed values already respect the asset's period, start alignment and deadtime). Returns the new position_id; review it with list_positions. If the chosen balance is type 'regular' this stakes real money — confirm the trade with the user first; use a 'training' balance to practice. Requires the write scope (see get_capabilities); accounts under regulatory restrictions are blocked with trading_access_denied even with the scope.

balance_id.description: One of the balance_id values from list_balances. The trade is staked against this balance; a 'regular' balance is real money. There is no default — this must be supplied.

asset_id.description: One of the asset_id values from list_assets.

direction.description: 'call' = the price will be above the open quote at expiration, 'put' = below. Any other value is rejected with a validation_error.

amount.description: Amount to stake, in the chosen balance's currency. Must be within the asset's minimum_amount/maximum_amount from list_assets and strictly greater than 0.

profit_percent.description: The asset's current profit_percent exactly as returned by list_assets. A stale or wrong value is rejected with a validation_error — re-run list_assets to refresh it.

expired.description: Expiration time as unix seconds (UTC). Pick one of the values from the asset's expirations list in list_assets — they are already aligned to the asset's start_time/period and past its deadtime. A value not offered there is rejected as misaligned/expired.

tools.name: rollover_position
tools.description: Move one of your currently open, currently-losing positions to the next expiration window instead of letting it expire, for a commission charged from the balance. Pass position_id and expiration_time — the position's CURRENT expiration as unix seconds; take the position's expiration field from list_positions (an ISO 8601 timestamp) and convert it to unix seconds. The backend derives the next window from it. Returns the resulting position_id. Fails with 'rollover_unavailable' / 'rollover_rejected' when the asset has no rollover configured, the window has closed, or the position is in the money. WRITE action that spends from the balance — confirm with the user on a 'regular' balance. Requires the write scope.

position_id.description: position_id of an open position, from the position_id field of list_positions.

expiration_time.description: The position's CURRENT expiration as unix seconds. Take the expiration field of its list_positions row (an ISO 8601 timestamp) and convert it to unix seconds. The next expiration window is derived from this value; a stale value is rejected.

tools.name: sell_position
tools.description: Close one of your currently open positions early at the current buyback price, before its expiration. Pass a position_id from list_positions (its sell_profit field previews the net result of selling now). Early sale is available only where the asset has buyback_enabled and more than buyback_deadtime_seconds remain before expiration; otherwise the call returns 'sell_rejected' and the position settles at expiration. On success returns a text confirmation. Requires the write scope.

position_id.description: position_id of an open position, from the position_id field of list_positions. History rows (get_trade_history) are already closed and cannot be sold.

Returns order_id; call list_positions to find the resulting position. If the chosen balance is type 'regular' this spends real money — confirm the trade with the user first; use a 'training' balance to practice. asset_id.description: Choose one of the asset IDs returned by the list_assets tool

amount.description: Amount to invest, denominated in the chosen balance's currency (the currency field of the selected list_balances row). Must be strictly greater than 0; a non-positive amount is rejected with a validation_error.

tools.name: sell_position
tools.description: Close one of your currently open positions early at the current market price, before its expiry. Pass a position_id from list_positions (its sell_profit field previews the net result of closing now). The realised result settles against the same balance the position is held on. On success returns a text confirmation that the position has been closed (no order_id). Requires the digital-options:write scope (see get_capabilities).

position_id.description: position_id of an open position, from the position_id field of list_positions. History rows (get_trade_history) are already closed and cannot be sold.

tools.name: calculate_order_size
tools.description: Preview the lots/units/margin tuple for a planned marginal-cfd order WITHOUT placing it (read-only). Pass exactly one of lots/units/margin plus leverage and the balance_currency; returns the snapped lots (a multiple of the instrument's quantity_step at or above min_quantity), the re-derived units/margin/notional, and buy/sell prices including spread. asset_id.description: Underlying asset id from list_assets / get_instruments to size the order for.

balance_currency.description: Currency code of the balance the trade will sit on (from list_balances)

units.description: Alternative input (provide exactly one of lots/units/margin): instrument units (lots × lot_size)

lots.description: Alternative input (provide exactly one of lots/units/margin): position size in lots

margin.description: Alternative input (provide exactly one of lots/units/margin): amount of client funds to commit in balance_currency

leverage.description: Leverage to assume when deriving margin/notional. Must be positive; should respect the equity-tier cap from get_instruments.

tools.name: cancel_pending_order
tools.description: Cancel a previously placed pending limit / stop / market-on-open order by order_id (from get_orders). WRITE action; idempotency-protected — a byte-identical retry within the hour returns idempotency_conflict rather than silently repeating, and a non-existent order_id returns not_found. Requires the write scope.

order_id.description: Id of the pending order to cancel, from get_orders. Must be positive.

tools.name: change_position_stop_loss

position_id.description: Id of the open position, from list_positions. Must be positive.

level.description: Trigger price for the protective order. A positive price sets or replaces it; 0 cancels the existing order. Must respect the instrument's stop_levels distance from get_instruments.

tools.name: get_candles

asset_id.description: Asset id to fetch candles for, from list_assets. Must be positive.

size.description: Candle width in seconds. Must be exactly one of: 1,5,10,15,30,60,120,300,600,900,1800,3600,7200,14400,28800,43200,86400,604800,2592000 (e.g. 60 = 1-minute, 3600 = hourly, 86400 = daily). Any other value is rejected with a validation_error.

count.description: Number of most-recent candles to return. Omit or pass 0 for the default of 100; max 1000. Values above 1000 (or negative) are rejected with a validation_error.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Report this token's access mode for marginal-cfd: read-write (write tools available to this token), read-only (market data and portfolio only), or none. The mode reflects token scopes; per-account trading restrictions may still apply at call time. Call this to learn why write tools may be absent from the tool list.

tools.name: get_instruments
tools.description: Get tradable marginal-cfd instruments for the requested asset, together with the leverage profiles they reference

asset_id.description: Underlying asset id from list_assets. Returns the asset's tradable instruments plus the leverage_profiles (equity-band tiers) and max_leverages that bound the leverage you may request.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Report the gateway's rate limits so you can pace calls and avoid rate_limited errors. Limits are enforced per user — shared across all of that user's tokens, not per token — over a rolling window. There is a global gateway cap across every call, plus separate read and write buckets; each tool counts against one bucket (write tools against 'write', everything else against 'read'). This reports the static limits, not live remaining counts; a rate_limited error already carries retry_after_ms and reset_at.

balance_id.description: The balance to query, from list_balances.

skip.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination (>= 0, default 0). Increase by limit to page.

limit.description: Max rows to return; default 50, max 500.

tools.description: List your closed marginal-cfd positions (trade history) for a balance

balance_id.description: The balance to query, from list_balances.

skip.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination (>= 0, default 0). Increase by limit to page.

limit.description: Max rows to return; default 50, max 500.

keep_position_open.description: Optional. Hint to keep the position open through events that would otherwise close it; omit to use the account default.

limit_price.description: Trigger price for the limit order, in the instrument's quote currency. Must be positive.

tools.name: calculate_order_size
tools.description: Preview the lots/units/margin tuple for a planned marginal-forex order WITHOUT placing it (read-only). Pass exactly one of lots/units/margin plus leverage and the balance_currency; returns the snapped lots (a multiple of the instrument's quantity_step at or above min_quantity), the re-derived units/margin/notional, and buy/sell prices including spread. Call this before any place_*_order to confirm size and required margin against the balance's free_margin, then pass the returned lots to the order tool. Providing zero or more than one of lots/units/margin is a validation_error.

asset_id.description: Underlying asset id from list_assets / get_instruments to size the order for.

balance_currency.description: Currency code of the balance the trade will sit on (from list_balances)

units.description: Alternative input (provide exactly one of lots/units/margin): instrument units (lots × lot_size)

lots.description: Alternative input (provide exactly one of lots/units/margin): position size in lots

margin.description: Alternative input (provide exactly one of lots/units/margin): amount of client funds to commit in balance_currency

leverage.description: Leverage to assume when deriving margin/notional. Must be positive; should respect the equity-tier cap from get_instruments.

tools.name: cancel_pending_order
tools.description: Cancel a previously placed pending limit / stop / market-on-open order by order_id (from get_orders). WRITE action; idempotency-protected — a byte-identical retry within the hour returns idempotency_conflict rather than silently repeating, and a non-existent order_id returns not_found. Requires the write scope.

order_id.description: Id of the pending order to cancel, from get_orders. Must be positive.

tools.name: change_position_stop_loss
tools.description: Set, move or cancel the stop-loss order on one of your currently open marginal-forex positions (position_id from list_positions). level is the stop-loss trigger price: a positive price sets or replaces the stop-loss; 0 cancels the existing one — cancelling removes the position's downside protection, so only do it on explicit user intent. Place the level on the correct side of the current price — BELOW it for a long position, ABOVE it for a short one — and respect the instrument's stop_levels distance from get_instruments: the backend does not reliably validate either, so a mis-placed level may be rejected, silently dropped, or trigger immediately. After the call, confirm the level via list_positions; if replacing an existing stop-loss fails with internal_error, cancel it first (level=0) and then set the new level. Returns the protective order's id and cancelled=true/false; this id is NOT a pending order and cannot be passed to cancel_pending_order. WRITE action, naturally idempotent — repeating the same call sets the same state and never creates anything new; a non-existent position_id returns not_found. Requires the write scope.

position_id.description: Id of the open position, from list_positions. Must be positive.

level.description: Trigger price for the protective order. A positive price sets or replaces it; 0 cancels the existing order. Must respect the instrument's stop_levels distance from get_instruments.

tools.name: change_position_take_profit
tools.description: Set, move or cancel the take-profit order on one of your currently open marginal-forex positions (position_id from list_positions). level is the take-profit trigger price: a positive price sets or replaces the take-profit; 0 cancels the existing one. Place the level on the correct side of the current price — ABOVE it for a long position, BELOW it for a short one — and respect the instrument's stop_levels distance from get_instruments: the backend does not reliably validate either, so a mis-placed level may be rejected, silently dropped, or trigger immediately. After the call, confirm the level via list_positions; if replacing an existing take-profit fails with internal_error, cancel it first (level=0) and then set the new level. Returns the protective order's id and cancelled=true/false; this id is NOT a pending order and cannot be passed to cancel_pending_order. WRITE action, naturally idempotent — repeating the same call sets the same state and never creates anything new; a non-existent position_id returns not_found. Requires the write scope.

position_id.description: Id of the open position, from list_positions. Must be positive.

level.description: Trigger price for the protective order. A positive price sets or replaces it; 0 cancels the existing order. Must respect the instrument's stop_levels distance from get_instruments.

tools.name: close_position
tools.description: Close one of your currently open marginal-forex positions by position_id (from list_positions), realizing its profit/loss. WRITE action; idempotency-protected — a byte-identical retry within the hour returns idempotency_conflict rather than silently repeating, and a non-existent position_id returns not_found. Requires the write scope.

position_id.description: Id of the open position to close, from list_positions. Must be positive.

tools.name: get_candles
tools.description: Get historical price candles for an asset (by asset_id from list_assets). Specify a candle size in seconds and an optional count (default 100, max 1000). Each candle has from/to timestamps and open/close/min/max prices.

asset_id.description: Asset id to fetch candles for, from list_assets. Must be positive.

size.description: Candle width in seconds. Must be exactly one of: 1,5,10,15,30,60,120,300,600,900,1800,3600,7200,14400,28800,43200,86400,604800,2592000 (e.g. 60 = 1-minute, 3600 = hourly, 86400 = daily). Any other value is rejected with a validation_error.

count.description: Number of most-recent candles to return. Omit or pass 0 for the default of 100; max 1000. Values above 1000 (or negative) are rejected with a validation_error.

tools.name: get_capabilities
tools.description: Report this token's access mode for marginal-forex: read-write (write tools available to this token), read-only (market data and portfolio only), or none. The mode reflects token scopes; per-account trading restrictions may still apply at call time. Call this to learn why write tools may be absent from the tool list.

tools.name: get_instruments
tools.description: Get tradable marginal-forex instruments for the requested asset, together with the leverage profiles they reference

asset_id.description: Underlying asset id from list_assets. Returns the asset's tradable instruments plus the leverage_profiles (equity-band tiers) and max_leverages that bound the leverage you may request.

tools.name: get_limits
tools.description: Report the gateway's rate limits so you can pace calls and avoid rate_limited errors. Limits are enforced per user — shared across all of that user's tokens, not per token — over a rolling window. There is a global gateway cap across every call, plus separate read and write buckets; each tool counts against one bucket (write tools against 'write', everything else against 'read'). This reports the static limits, not live remaining counts; a rate_limited error already carries retry_after_ms and reset_at.

tools.name: get_orders
tools.description: List currently open / pending marginal-forex orders for a balance

balance_id.description: The balance to query, from list_balances.

skip.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination (>= 0, default 0). Increase by limit to page.

limit.description: Max rows to return; default 50, max 500.

tools.name: get_trade_history

balance_id.description: The balance to query, from list_balances.

skip.description: Number of rows to skip for pagination (>= 0, default 0). Increase by limit to page.

limit.description: Max rows to return; default 50, max 500.

tools.name: list_assets
tools.description: List underlying assets available for marginal-forex trading

only_enabled.description: Set to true to only show currently available assets, false to show everything. Default is true.

asset_type.description: Optional exact-match filter on an asset's category. Use the asset_type value returned by list_assets; only assets whose asset_type equals this string are kept.

tools.name: list_balances
tools.description: List marginal-forex balances with portfolio details (equity, margin, pnl, free margin). Each balance carries a type: 'regular' is real money, 'training' is demo funds. Use the returned balance_id (and its currency) for get_orders / list_positions / get_trade_history and the place_*_order tools — there is no default account. Filter with the types parameter.

types.description: Optional balance-type filter (case-insensitive). ALL (default; regular + training), NORMAL (regular only), TRAINING (demo only). Omit for ALL; any other value is rejected with a validation_error.

tools.name: list_positions

tools.name: place_market_order
tools.description: Place a new marginal-forex market order (fills immediately at the current price). WRITE action that opens a position and, on a 'regular' balance, spends real money — confirm with the user first. Pre-check size with calculate_order_size. Optional take_profit/stop_loss must respect the instrument's stop_levels from get_instruments — a level too close to the price is rejected. The gateway verifies the fill: if the backend acknowledges an order id but no position opens, it returns 'not_filled' — if you sent take_profit/stop_loss, widen or drop it (it likely breached stop_levels); otherwise check the asset is open for trading. Do not blindly resend. Requires the write scope.
